card.name: Per-kilogram dose units
card.fires_on: The unit part "/kg" (or "units" or "2" in /m 2) right after a dose amount such as mg or mcg, in dosing instructions.

modes.label: Per-kg dose
modes.description: The "kg" piece of "/kg" after a number and mg or mcg in a weight-based dose.
